newsitem.title: USA: McKesson unit to build Maryland facility.
newsitem.headline: McKesson unit to build Maryland facility.

text.p: McKesson Corp's McKesson BioServices subsidiary said it will build a 76,500-square-foot facility to house its Pharmaceutical Services Division.
McKesson BioServices provides biomedical support services to the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries, U.S. government, universities and institutions, and contract research organizations.
When completed, the facility will accommodate up to 30 new employees. Construction should be finished in January 1998, it said.
